content.text:
Yes—these Munich bakeries confirm that they sell sourdough bread:

**Sourdough-focused**
- **Brotatelier** — Tumblingerstraße 45, 80337. It says all its baked goods are leavened exclusively with sourdough; it sells rye, spelt and wheat loaves. ([muenchen.tv](https://www.muenchen.tv/amp/mediathek/video/wo-brot-noch-zeit-bekommt-zu-besuch-in-der-sauerteig-backstube-brotatelier/?utm_source=openai))
- **Brotraum** — Herzogstraße 6, 80803. Its range includes sourdough rolls and focaccia, alongside breads. ([brotraum.bio](https://brotraum.bio/brotzeit?utm_source=openai))
- **Bageri** — Adlzreiterstraße 21, 80337. A Scandinavian-style bakery that uses sourdough and Bavarian organic flour; its menu varies. ([bageri.de](https://bageri.de/?utm_source=openai))
- **Julius Brantner Brothandwerk** — Nordendstraße 23, 80801; also has locations at Kreuzstraße 1 and Pariser Straße 38. ([julius-brantner.de](https://julius-brantner.de/de/presse?utm_source=openai))

**More options**
- **Hofpfisterei** — Many locations around Munich, with a broad range of natural-sourdough breads. ([hofpfisterei.de](https://www.hofpfisterei.de/?utm_source=openai))
- **Bäckerei Stadler** — Einstein­straße 86, 81675, and Marktstraße 18, 80802; the bakery says it uses natural sourdoughs. ([baeckereistadler.de](https://www.baeckereistadler.de/?utm_source=openai))
- **Bäckerei Zöttl** — A Munich bakery with a Bauernlaib made from its own sourdough. ([zoettl.de](https://zoettl.de/?utm_source=openai))

For an especially sourdough-centric selection, I’d start with **Brotatelier, Brotraum or Brantner**. Check opening hours and availability before heading over—some smaller shops have limited hours or sell out.
